[Workflow harness — assistant context] The request above may reply to the assistant message that immediately preceded it, relayed indented below as context only — assistant prose, not the user speaking:
  Fixed. Refresh the slot page and the panel under Listing will reach all the way to the bottom. Your current layout repairs itself, so you don't need to reset anything.
  
  **What was wrong:** Every panel had a bottom-edge handle that saved a fixed height. When you added a panel under one you'd shortened, the new stack kept that old height, and nothing gave you a handle to undo it. The review had flagged this too, but the run ended before it got fixed.
  
  **How it works now:**

  - The Commerce page keeps its own height handles, since it isn't a one-screen workspace.
  
  **Checked:**

result.thesis: The channel page is where a buyer decides whether this creator's time is worth holding. It is a due-diligence desk in the slot workspace's chrome with three windows, each named for one question. Listings asks what can I buy now and how did the rest go: a dense blotter of every listing, live then resolved, each row expanding into a dossier. Track record asks whether this creator's listings settle and deliver: per-listing facts and counts, never a score. Audience asks whether the audience is real and growing: measured readings over a stated window, in neutral ink. Every number is named by what it is (Ask, Buyout, Settled, List price, Last shown before blackout). There is no channel price, no score, no 24h change and no hero number, because the platform has no number for a channel. Sealed listings are sealed in the data layer and fail closed on the ticking server clock. No listing disappears, and panes are documents, never a second workspace.
result.first_five_seconds: On a 1440×900 desktop nothing is below the fold, because the page is a one-viewport board. Top left, the Listings window gives every live listing one row: phase chip, one named price (ASK $1.2500 / BUYOUT $2.9405 / 🔒 Sealed), % sold, whether it meets the settlement conditions (✓ Met / ○ 4/10 trades), and a server-clock countdown (OPENS 19d 08h / AUCTION 5d 08h / SETTLES 26h 20m, amber). Sealed rows are hatched amber with a 2px amber edge and cannot be mistaken for trading ones. Below them sits every resolved listing with its outcome (✓ SETTLED $15.2000 +1.3% vs list, × FAILED, × EXPIRED) and delivery (Published · 96h [Sim] / Awaiting brief). On the right, Track record tallies settled, failed, expired and self-consolidated, with each settlement against its list price; Audience reads "343K ▲ +15.6% 90D" over a neutral line chart. A buyer gets the risk profile, for example "one liquid listing live, conditions met, opens in 19 days; no record yet; audience growing", before reading any prose.

sections.name: Frame and modes
sections.purpose: Board at ≥1024×600 outside a pane: the slot page's PaneCanvas with a fixed tree row[Listings 64 | column[Track record 56, Audience 44]], walls draggable, sizes under ag_channel_ws, saved only after a gesture, each window scrolling inside. Flow everywhere else: the same windows stacked with title bars, plus a sticky jump bar on phones. Pane mode: no header or back, a 28px pane head, links target _top.

sections.name: ChannelHeader
sections.purpose: A compact ~68px band modelled on SlotHeader: back to /channels, 'YouTube · Sports' meta, LiveDot, 'Public record →', a 32px avatar, an 18px name, @handle, and badges (Your channel cyan, Example slate, MockBadge). Creator-only actions: List a slot and Studio. A full variant for flow. Removes the 80px hero, the brand-red eyebrow, the follower count and Trade Time.

sections.name: Listings window (blotter)
sections.purpose: Every listing (≤50) in two tables, Live (sorted by next milestone) and Resolved (newest close first). One DOM per row: a grid when wide, using display:contents line wrappers, and two flex lines when narrow; validated in a prototype. Each row shows one named price, sold %, conditions, a countdown or outcome, vs list and delivery. Container queries add Trd, Hld, a trade sparkline, Accts and Winner at ≥50rem. A roving-tabindex disclosure button opens an inset dossier.

sections.name: Listing dossier
sections.purpose: Per state, built from reused pieces: SettlementStrip card (or a new SealedNotice 'listing' variant when sealed), Terms (now exported), schedule, market (bookSummary and tapeSummary), holder concentration without names, conditions verdict, a time-scaled TradeSpark (stops at the blackout cutoff, then hatch), the viewer's own overlay, and actions (Open slot, Place a sealed order, Set the consolidation date, Fulfillment tracker). Resolved listings show settled vs list, accounts, winner share, consolidator 'Advertiser', delivery, and simulated-measurement labels.

sections.name: Track record window
sections.purpose: A summary of the public record, from /api/creator/<id>/history/ joined to the slot list. Head tallies: settled, failed, expired, self-consolidated. Sections: settled vs list price per listing, grouped by slot type and never blended, each row revealing its listing; delivery; conduct (self-consolidations, complaints, reports filed by the creator); advertisers. Closed history shows a neutral 'No public history · closed {date}' state that keeps the public §8 facts. Foot links to the full public record.

sections.name: Audience window
sections.purpose: Measured context, never a price. Range chips in the title bar (7D 30D 90D 1Y All, default 90D) scope a figure strip: subscribers or followers, views, videos, last reading, each with a neutral ▲/▼ delta labelled by window. One slate-300 linear line chart, with no area fill, nice ticks, a direct end label, and a custom tooltip with the value first. A Subscribers/Views toggle, honest empty and thin states, mock, example and provenance notes, and a readings table as the accessible twin.

sections.name: Simulated figures dialog
sections.purpose: Keeps today's best element: exact shown-versus-real figures. Fixes the false 'prices off those numbers' copy, raises contrast, and adds dialog semantics with focus return.

sections.name: Page states and data
sections.purpose: State keyed by route id, with each feed failing on its own. A 404 shows 'not found', a 500 shows an error with Retry, and a delisted channel still shows its listings. Per-window Stale badges, plus a skeleton of the real layout instead of a spinner. Feeds: authFetch slot list (10s while live, else 60s), creator (60s), history and metrics (120s), and /api/dashboard/ once when signed in for ownership. Masking and identity stripping live in tested pure utils.

cuts: '24H CHANGE ▲ 0.0%' tile: the field is never sent and belonged to the removed appraisal (R1)
Followers and Open Slots tiles: they repeat the header and the list
80px avatar with brand glow, 30px name, red YOUTUBE eyebrow: a hero identity on a data page, with brand colour used as UI colour
'Trade Time →': it picks an arbitrary slot, targets the creator's own slot and loops in panes
Text 'Back' with navigate(-1): replaced by an explicit back to /channels
'Channel history' with two monotone area charts, padded ticks and the default tooltip: replaced by one neutral linear line with nice ticks and a custom tooltip
1H and 24H ranges: one reading draws a lone dot
'Open Slots' list: hard-coded TRADING label, unlabelled base_rate, no seal
'Settled Deals' table: omits fulfillment and falls back to base_rate under 'Settlement price'; replaced by Resolved rows and Track record
'Public record' card: a 92px card for one link that collides with the next; now header and foot links
'(§1.1)' citation in user copy: the statement stays, legible, in the Listings foot
Dead code: chartType, SLOT_TYPE_TABS, the m.price branch, duplicated label maps, inline toFixed and toLocaleDateString
risks: Payload weight: the slot list returns full slot payloads (about 10-35KB each, up to ~1.5MB for 50) at a 10s poll; mitigated by a 60s cadence when nothing is live and by keepIfSame
Reusing PaneCanvas on a second page: the storage prefix must be ag_channel_ws, never ag_slot_*; the tree is static with no add or close
display:contents row wrappers: the disclosure button never takes contents; needs a keyboard and screen-reader QA pass
Container-query column budgets were measured in a prototype at the default split (~43.5rem); re-check at the 1024px floor

Fixtures expire: channel 17 is sealed only until 2026-11-10 20:20 UTC (then 'Settling now'), 16 seals around Nov 15, and 18's brief deadline passes around Nov 11; multi-listing, closed-history and mock states need the audit's stubs
The pane can trail its host by one poll; the clock-based fail-closed seal covers the blackout edge, while other figures may lag up to 10s
Marking the host slot needs sign-off on a one-line ROUTE_WINDOWS change; the parent-path fallback can be stale for one poll
'Vs list' compares against the list price at close, not the original ask (base_rate is overwritten on reprice)
The server substitutes 'Tech' for a blank category, so the page can show an invented category (pre-existing; flagged)
Recharts accessibilityLayer keyboard behaviour in 3.8 must be verified; the readings table is the fallback
